title: Pedagogical Animation Quality and Semantic Generalization Evaluation
frozen_research_questions: Does the V3-47 visual grammar add physically visible semantic evidence at frozen beat times without changing narration?
Does the model-facing contract incorrectly accept changed mathematical or process topics under fixed claim IDs?
Can independent blinded evaluators prefer the rendered explanation and answer a source-grounded comprehension question, without source/variant identity being leaked?

cohort_protocol.randomized_pairwise_blinding: Deterministic A/B per scene, same physical narration, randomized by preregistered SHA-based seed; provenance manifest must be kept away from reviewers.
cohort_protocol.analysis: Paired per-criterion scores and free-text timestamp evidence; do not infer learning gains or preference without actual participants and independent ratings.
cohort_protocol.learner_study_method: Counterbalanced assignment + unseen post-video transfer question; no statistical superiority assertion if not executed.

research_nonclaims: Two synthetic family pairs are not broad topic generalization or a human A/B study.
Geometry-only heldout is not unseen curriculum.
Descriptive event/pixel counts do not measure causal learning gain.
Legacy fixed claim bank permits no new fraction or condition truth; a valid 2/3-to-4/6 mathematical transformation may still be out of semantic scope.
